QuestInfo.name: Tapping at the Window
QuestInfo.0: #b#p606##k at the #m10005001# looks like nobody at the hotel has slept in days.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p606##k says something taps on the windows of the #m10005001# every night, and the guests hear a voice say their names. #b#p606##k hopes it's only the #r#o17#s#k from the Ant Tunnel. I need to defeat #r30 #o17#s#k in #m10005064# and #m10005065#, and bring back #b30 #t4000017#s#k for a chime.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #r#o17#s#k and brought back their wings. The tapping stopped, and the guests slept. But the guest in Room 3 still won't open his door.

0.0: Welcome to the #m10005001#. Please... keep your voice down. Nobody here has slept in days.
0.1: Every night, something taps on the windows. Tap. Tap. Tap. The guest in Room 3 says it taps on his window too. Room 3 has no window.
0.2: The guests also hear wings, and then a voice saying their names. I told them it's just the #r#o17#s#k from the Ant Tunnel. ...It is just the #r#o17#s#k, isn't it?
0.3: Please go down and defeat #r30 #o17#s#k in #m10005064# and #m10005065#. And bring me #b30 #t4000017#s#k. An old guest once told me that a chime made of their own wings keeps them away.

yes.0: Thank you. The Ant Tunnel starts right here in #m10005000#. Go deep enough and you'll hear them. If you hear your name... don't answer.

no.0: I understand. I'll keep the lights on again tonight. All of them.

1.0: You're back. Last night, the tapping stopped, and everyone slept. And you brought the wings.
1.1: Well, almost everyone. The guest in Room 3 still won't open his door. He says it isn't over. Here, take this for your trouble.

mob.0: The tapping hasn't stopped. Please defeat #r30 #o17#s#k in #m10005064# and #m10005065#.

item.0: I still need #b30 #t4000017#s#k. The #r#o17#s#k in the Ant Tunnel drop them.
